description.value: A regional district campground along Pass Creek near the small community of Crescent Valley in the West Kootenay, offering a creek-side setting as a handy overnight on the Slocan Valley corridor. Amenity details are sparse from available sources, so verify facilities before arriving.

All optional amenity fields must remain null due to lack of substantive page content.
